note: Three workers at once: 115,565,604 cells each, ~3.0 GB each, ~9.1 GB together on a 31 GB box.  A constant CELL ceiling does not know what else is running, which is why the ladder prices in GB against MemAvailable read at ladder start.
what: D-626 -- what one maze3d.Field CELL actually costs in RAM, measured on three concurrent 0.020 mm workers rather than assumed.  LADDER_CELL_BUDGET was a TIME bound wearing a memory bound's units; this is the constant that lets --grid-gb price a rung in the unit that kills (gigabytes against THIS box), and lets --grid-seconds carry the time question separately.
